subject: Quick 20-min ramp + slot options for DataDock activity spike
message_1_subject: Quick 20-min ramp + slot options for DataDock activity spike
message_1_body:
Hi Anika,

Congrats — our system flagged a usage surge on your DataDock trial from this week (nice work!). I wanted to offer a short, focused 20-minute session to walk through a few high-impact knobs (inference batching, prefix caching, and a quick prompt test) so you can keep performance tight while scaling.

Proposed slots (your local time — happy to adjust):
- Tue Oct 8, 09:00–09:20 IST
- Tue Oct 8, 13:00–13:20 IST
- Wed Oct 9, 16:30–16:50 IST

If none of those work, tell me two 30‑minute windows that do and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ll include Ben Carter (solutions) on the call for a short integration checklist.

If helpful, here’s a quick calendar link: https://calendly.com/rafael-mendes/20min

Thanks — looking forward to helping get you set up.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
SDR, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachment: RDW-20min-checklist.pdf (2 pages — checklist for the session)
message_2_subject: Re: Quick 20-min ramp + slot options for DataDock activity spike
message_2_body:
Thanks Rafael — really appreciate the flag. We did run a batch job that pushed us up; would love a short session. The first two slots work for me, prefer Tue Oct 8 at 13:00 IST.

Quick context: we’re testing multi-tenant scoring and want to make sure we’re not losing latency at 1k qps. If Ben can cover some of the infra tips that’d be great.

Best,
Anika
Head of ML, DataDock Labs
